text:
Sam: quick RFC-followup idea: introduce a delta-compat lane that only runs lightweight diffs against the most recent vetted model to avoid full validation on every push. sketch: fast deterministic checks + delta-eval on stratified prompts.
Rina: nice. what do you mean by deterministic checks?
Sam: things that must be identical or near-identical: tokenizer tokenization map, model fingerprint (arch+export_tool+quant_bits), KV cache shape, and kernel selection map. these are cheap to compute.
Devon: and delta-eval is a small sample of outputs compared with baseline and a divergence score?
Sam: yep. target ~120 prompts across short/med/long, compute embedding-diff + LM-based hallucination heuristics. if delta < threshold, mark DELTA_PASS and allow rollout. else trigger full validation.
Yusuf: thresholds need owners. also how to avoid gaming (small sample misses regressions)?
Rina: make triggers conservative: if quant_bits change or arch changes, always run full validation. delta-eval only for same-arch, same-quant candidates.
Devon: Console UX: add signal delta_status and baseline_id. Rollout policy can require DELTA_PASS for dev tenants and FULL_PASS for prod.
Sam: action items: 1) Sam+Rina draft delta metrics and thresholds, 2) Devon wire console flags + API, 3) Yusuf estimate cost savings and failure-rate tradeoffs.
onboard-bot: created ticket ONB-8022 "delta-compat lane: metric spec" (assignee: Rina).
Yusuf: I'll run a small sim on last 30 models to estimate false-negative risk.
Rina: SG, will also suggest stratification and a tiny golden set. :thumbsup:
Sam: cool, closing this quick thread.
